text: Sea's e-commerce cost of revenue rose 38.6%, from US$5.2 billion in FY2023 to US$7.2 billion in FY2024. According to the company, this increase was "primarily driven by the increase in logistics costs as orders volume grew 33.0% from 8.2 billion in 2023 to 10.9 billion in 2024" — i.e., higher order volumes on Shopee drove up logistics and related value-added service costs, which form the largest component of e-commerce cost of revenue (alongside bank transaction fees, server/hosting costs, and staff compensation) [Sea, FY2024, p.97].

answer: Sea's e-commerce cost of revenue rose 38.6%, from US$5.2 billion in FY2023 to US$7.2 billion in FY2024.
